universe_anchor.writing_genre_rationale: El Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form es un formulario operativo real del Puerto de Buenaventura. Tiene CAMPOS DISCRETOS que naturalmente fuerzan los 8 grammar targets PM-2.10: (1) Header → AT (point/time) GT-S3-02, (2) Equipment Location → IN/ON GT-S3-01, ON/AT GT-S3-02, UNDER/BEHIND GT-S3-03, IN FRONT OF/NEXT TO/BETWEEN GT-S3-04, (3) Deck Status → be GT-S3-06 + there is/are GT-S3-07, (4) Shift Operations → simple present 3rd -s GT-S3-05, (5) Combinatoric → AND GT-S3-08. Es A1.2 friendly: oraciones cortas (≤12 palabras), vocabulario controlado (Toolbelt 25), scaffolding visual por campo. Maritime auténtico: usado en puertos colombianos del Pacífico (Buenaventura · Tumaco) según ficha funciones oficial muelle pm-1-2.bloque_B.

bilingual_unified_header.english: WRITING WORKSHOP — You are Andrea. Captain Restrepo is waiting for your Pre-Shift Form. Captain Lopera will sign it. Without the form, the shift does not start.

blueprint_model.title: THE BLUEPRINT MODEL — How a Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form Works
blueprint_model.genre_analyzed: Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form (formulario operativo portuario auténtico)
structural_moves: Move 1 — Header: vessel name + berth + date + shift time (uses AT for time/point · GT-S3-02)

Move 2 — Equipment Location: 4 lines describing where critical items are on the vessel and dock (uses ON / AT / IN · GT-S3-01,02 · UNDER / BEHIND · GT-S3-03 · IN FRONT OF / NEXT TO / BETWEEN · GT-S3-04)
Move 3 — Deck Status: 2-3 lines using there is / there are (GT-S3-07) + be descriptive (GT-S3-06)
Move 4 — Shift Operations: 3-4 lines describing what happens this shift (simple present 3rd singular -s · GT-S3-05) · optional combining with AND (GT-S3-08)
Move 5 — Sign-off: apprentice signature line (Andrea Mosquera) + master countersignature line (Captain Lopera)
communicative_functions_in_action: F1 — Identifying objects and their location (Where is the lifeboat? It is IN FRONT OF the bridge)
F2 — Describing routine vessel/port operations (What does the crew do? The crew loads the containers)
F3 — Stating presence/absence (Is there a tug? · There are 24 containers on deck)
F4 — Reporting facts in formal register (operational reporting · apprentice → master)
blueprint_model.adapted_example_from_anchor: From PM-2.3 Master Anchor 'Operational Report BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS' the chunk 'The bow is to the north. The stern is to the south. The bridge is on the top deck. The crane is on the dock' becomes Move 2+3 of the form: 'The bow is to the north. The stern is to the south. The bridge is on top. The crane is ON the dock. There are 24 containers on deck.'

archetype_A_EXPLORATORY.archetype_name: A — Exploratory Writing (Quickwrite de bajo impacto · destrabar la página en blanco)
archetype_A_EXPLORATORY.purpose_in_integrated_sequence: Antes de la producción formal, Andrea hace un quickwrite de 5 minutos sobre 'todo lo que veo desde el muelle de Berth 4' para vencer la ansiedad de la página en blanco y generar léxico personal que luego reusará en el formulario.

PRE_writing.prompt_bilingual_unified: Look at the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS at Berth 4. Write everything you see for 5 minutes. No grammar, no spelling — just words and phrases. (*Mira el BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS en el Muelle 4. Escribe todo lo que ves durante 5 minutos. Sin gramática, sin ortografía — solo palabras y frases.*)
instructions: Open your notebook to a blank page
Write continuously — DO NOT stop, DO NOT correct, DO NOT translate full sentences
Use English when you can · Spanish words allowed in this stage only
Goal: at least 30 words/phrases on the page when timer ends

DURING_writing.task: Continuous quickwrite — fluency over accuracy · sin corrección del instructor durante los 5 min
DURING_writing.expected_output_sample_maritime: containers on deck · big vessel · BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS · bridge on top · captain on the bridge · dock wet · crew working · cargo in warehouse · berth 4 · stern back · bow front · lifeboat orange · crane behind warehouse · 07:00 shift starts · cold morning · Captain Lopera writes · Captain Restrepo signs · bollards near bow · mooring lines tight · Channel 16 VHF · Roger · Wilco · arrives at 07:00...

POST_writing.selection_action: Andrea highlights any 5-7 items from her quickwrite that she will reuse in the formal Inspection Form (especially Move 2 — Equipment Location and Move 3 — Deck Status)
POST_writing.reflection_prompt_bilingual: Which words can I use in my formal form? (*¿Cuáles palabras puedo usar en mi formulario formal?*) · 1-line answer in EN or ES.

archetype_A_EXPLORATORY.instructor_acts_as: Writing Fluency Coach & ESP Low-Stakes Writing Specialist — keeps anxiety low, no correction during the 5 minutes, simply circulates and reassures
archetype_A_EXPLORATORY.maritime_worked_example: Andrea's quickwrite contains: 'big vessel at berth 4 · containers on deck · captain on the bridge · lifeboat in front of bridge · crane behind warehouse · bollards near bow'. She circles 6 of these phrases and carries them into Archetype E genre analysis and Archetype B drafting.

archetype_E_GENRE_BASED.archetype_name: E — Genre-Based Writing (análisis del formulario como género · recipe extraction)
archetype_E_GENRE_BASED.purpose_in_integrated_sequence: ANTES de la producción formal (Archetype B), la clase analiza 2 ejemplares auténticos de Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form para extraer la 'receta del género'. Esta receta guía toda la producción y termina con un mini-ejercicio de transferencia (CML CARRIER en Berth 7).

exemplars_presented: Exemplar 1 — A real Pre-Shift Inspection Form from Puerto de Buenaventura (anonymized · container vessel · Berth 4 · pulled from pm-1-2.bloque_B fuentes auténticas)
Exemplar 2 — A simplified A1.2 version of an SMCP-aligned inspection form from the IMARPOR manual (curated to ≤12 words/sentence)
key_questions_bilingual: What 5 sections do both forms have? (*¿Qué 5 secciones tienen ambos formularios?*)
Which words appear in EVERY equipment-location line? (*¿Qué palabras aparecen en CADA línea de ubicación?*) — answer: ON / AT / IN / BEHIND / IN FRONT OF
How long is each sentence? (*¿Qué tan largas son las oraciones?*) — answer: ≤12 words

body_must_include: ≥4 lines of equipment location with prepositions (ON/AT/IN + BEHIND/IN FRONT OF/NEXT TO/BETWEEN)
≥2 lines of deck status using be + there is/are
≥3 lines of operations in simple present 3rd person -s
genre_recipe_class_built.register: Formal operativo · short clauses · no contractions · no slang
genre_recipe_class_built.length_a12: 60-90 words · 8-12 short sentences · ≤12 words per sentence

production_step_by_step: Step 1 — Identify communicative purpose: Document vessel readiness before shift start
Step 2 — Select register: Formal operativo (apprentice → mentor + master)
Step 3 — Structure by 5 moves recipe (header / location / status / operations / sign-off)
Step 4 — Plug in vocabulary from Toolbelt 25 (PM-2.3) + 8 grammar targets (PM-2.10)
Step 5 — Compare against the 2 exemplars · adjust syntax to ≤12 words/sentence

POST_writing.transfer_exercise: Now write the same kind of form but for a DIFFERENT vessel: CML CARRIER at Berth 7, evening shift starting AT 19:00. Write only 4 lines (1 header + 2 location + 1 operation) — show you can transfer the recipe. (*Ahora escribe el mismo tipo de formulario pero para otro buque · 4 líneas · demuestra que dominas la receta.*)
auditor_checklist_genre_specific: Does my form have all 5 moves?
Does it look like a real Pre-Shift Form (header at top · signatures at bottom)?
Is my register formal operativo (no contractions · no slang)?
Did I keep each sentence ≤12 words?

archetype_E_GENRE_BASED.instructor_acts_as: Genre Specialist & ESP Text-Type Architect — guides recipe extraction by Socratic questions · models transfer to new vessel on the board
archetype_E_GENRE_BASED.maritime_worked_example: Class extracts recipe from Exemplar 1 (BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS Berth 4) and Exemplar 2 (IMARPOR manual SMCP-aligned). Recipe: 'Header AT-line, 4 location lines with ON/AT/IN/BEHIND/IN FRONT OF/NEXT TO/BETWEEN, 2 there is/are + be lines, 3 simple present operation lines, sign-off.' Andrea's transfer exercise: 4-line form for CML CARRIER at Berth 7 evening shift — proves she owns the genre. Sample: 'Vessel: CML CARRIER · Berth: AT Berth 7 · Date: 28 April · Shift starts AT 19:00. The pilot is ON the bridge. The tug is IN FRONT OF the bow. The vessel arrives AT 19:00.'

archetype_B_ACADEMIC_FORMAL.archetype_name: B — Academic/Formal Writing (borrador formal scaffolded · sentence frames + 5 moves)
archetype_B_ACADEMIC_FORMAL.purpose_in_integrated_sequence: Andrea produce el primer borrador completo del Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form usando sentence frames y la estructura de 5 moves derivada del Archetype E. Esta es la fase de producción central: 60 minutos · 60-90 palabras · todos los 8 grammar targets activados.

PRE_writing.mentor_text_analysis: Class re-reads the Master Anchor Text PM-2.3 'Operational Report BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS' and identifies 5 sentences that match the 5 moves of the form. The class extracts patterns: (1) header 'AT Berth 4' / 'AT 18:00', (2) location 'The crane is on the dock', (3) deck status 'The mooring lines are ready', (4) operations 'We coordinate with the dock team', (5) sign-off 'Captain Lopera. Master.'
key_questions: Where do we use ON, AT, IN? (*¿Dónde usamos cada preposición?*) — ON surface · AT point/time · IN closed space
Where do we use UNDER, BEHIND, IN FRONT OF? — relative position
Which operations use 'arrives, leaves, loads' (-s) and which use 'work, load, depart' (no -s)? — 3rd singular vs plural/1st

Move_2_Equipment_Location: The cargo is IN ____________. [GT-S3-01 IN closed space]
The lifeboat is IN FRONT OF ____________. [GT-S3-04]
The forklift is NEXT TO ____________ · The vessel is BETWEEN Berth __ AND Berth __. [GT-S3-04]
Move_3_Deck_Status: Andrea is ____________ [the apprentice/the dock officer/at the bow]. [GT-S3-06]
Move_4_Shift_Operations: I ____________ AT 07:00 AND we ____________ the bow station [work/start/coordinate]. [GT-S3-05 plural/1st + GT-S3-08 AND]

DURING_writing.grammar_targets_inline_reminders: Each frame has a colored micro-capsule reminder: BLUE = preposition target (GT-S3-01..04) · GREEN = simple present target (GT-S3-05) · YELLOW = be / there is target (GT-S3-06,07) · ORANGE = AND connector (GT-S3-08).
DURING_writing.grammar_target_minimum_count: 8/8 targets present · per pm-2-10.writing_pm24_must_use_minimum=5 · pero implementación IMARPOR-CC fuerza 8/8 por scaffold del formulario

POST_writing.self_review: Andrea reads her draft once aloud · checks each blank is filled · counts grammar target occurrences using the Auditor's Checklist · verifies sentence count (8-12) and word count (60-90).

archetype_B_ACADEMIC_FORMAL.instructor_acts_as: Academic Writing Instructor & ESP Formal Communication Specialist — provides structure + sentence frames, recasts errors during 1:1 mini-conferences (≤2 min per learner)
archetype_B_ACADEMIC_FORMAL.maritime_worked_example_full_draft: Vessel: BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS · Berth: AT Berth 4 · Date: 28 April · Shift starts AT 07:00. The containers are ON deck. The captain is ON the bridge. The cargo is IN the warehouse. The lifeboat is IN FRONT OF the bridge. The crane is BEHIND the warehouse. The forklift is NEXT TO the container. There are 24 containers on deck. There is a bridge on top. The dock is wet. Andrea is the apprentice. The vessel arrives AT 07:00. Captain Lopera leaves the bridge. The crew loads the containers. I work AT Berth 4 AND we coordinate the bow station. Apprentice: Andrea Mosquera · Master: Captain Lopera. [Word count: 86 · Sentences: 14 · GT coverage: 8/8 · Toolbelt terms: 12]

archetype_C_COLLABORATIVE_TBLT.archetype_name: C — Collaborative TBLT Writing (peer review en trios por roles · Apprentice/Mentor/Master)
archetype_C_COLLABORATIVE_TBLT.purpose_in_integrated_sequence: Trios revisan los borradores entre sí con roles asignados — simula la realidad portuaria donde la Inspection Form es revisada por mentor + master antes de firmar. Genuine negotiation of meaning · L1 permitido cuando el aprendiz se atora.

PRE_writing.scenario_brief_bilingual: Your trio is the Berth 4 morning team: one Apprentice (writer · Andrea role), one Mentor (Capitán Restrepo role · checks coherence), one Master (Captain Lopera role · checks operational accuracy). Rotate roles every ~15 min so each member reviews two drafts. (*Tu trío es el equipo matutino de Berth 4: un aprendiz · un mentor · un capitán-master. Roten cada 15 min.*)
PRE_writing.registers_to_negotiate: Formal operativo (no contractions · no slang · full clauses · ≤12 words/sentence)

trio_roles_and_tasks.Apprentice_role: Reads draft aloud · accepts/rejects each peer suggestion with a one-word reason (yes/no + reason) · documents final version on her form
trio_roles_and_tasks.Mentor_Restrepo_role: Checks Move structure (5 moves present?) + Auditor's Checklist coherence · validates length 60-90 words · validates sentence count 8-12
trio_roles_and_tasks.Master_Lopera_role: Checks operational accuracy: is the vessel really AT Berth 4? Do the times match the shift? Are containers really ON deck? Does the form make sense as an operational document Lopera would sign?

negotiation_prompts_bilingual: Is 'AT Berth 4' correct here, or should it be 'IN Berth 4'? (*¿Es correcto AT o debería ser IN?*) — answer: AT (point/location · GT-S3-02)
Does 'the captain leaves' need -s? (*¿lleva -s?*) — yes, 3rd person singular (GT-S3-05)
Are there really 24 containers ON deck or IN the deck? — answer: ON (surface · GT-S3-01)
Should it be 'There IS 24 containers' or 'There ARE 24 containers'? (*¿IS o ARE?*) — ARE (plural · GT-S3-07)
Can we combine these two sentences with AND? — yes, only when both are short (GT-S3-08)

POST_writing.group_evaluation: Each trio presents one final form to the class · class votes 'Would Captain Lopera sign this?' (yes/no with reason) · top 3 forms read aloud as exemplars
POST_writing.reflection_bilingual: What did we negotiate the most? (*¿Qué fue lo que más negociamos?*) — typical answers: ON vs IN, -s vs no -s, IS vs ARE, AT vs IN for time

archetype_C_COLLABORATIVE_TBLT.instructor_acts_as: Collaborative Writing Architect & ESP Pragmatics Specialist — circulates, supports negotiation in L1 when needed (~15% L1 budget), does NOT correct directly, lets peers self-resolve
archetype_C_COLLABORATIVE_TBLT.maritime_worked_example: Trio T-1 (Andrea + Juan + María): María (Master role) flags Juan's 'The vessel arrive at 07:00' — Andrea (Apprentice role) accepts, changes to 'arrives' (GT-S3-05). Juan (Mentor role) flags María's 'The crane is on the warehouse' — María accepts, changes to 'BEHIND the warehouse' (GT-S3-03). Andrea negotiates with María: 'There IS 24 containers' → 'There ARE 24 containers' (GT-S3-07). Juan suggests combining 'I work AT Berth 4. We coordinate the bow' into 'I work AT Berth 4 AND we coordinate the bow station' (GT-S3-08).

archetype_D_AI_MEDIATED.archetype_name: D — AI-Mediated Writing (prompt literacy crítico · IA como detector de errores)
archetype_D_AI_MEDIATED.purpose_in_integrated_sequence: Andrea usa una IA (ChatGPT / Copilot) para encontrar errores en su borrador YA editado por el trio. Reflexiona sobre qué acepta y qué rechaza. La IA es herramienta, NO autora — el formulario final sigue siendo 100% de Andrea.

PRE_writing.first_draft_solo: Andrea already has her trio-revised draft (output of Archetype C). She does NOT use AI before this point — IA aparece solo en post-editing crítico.
PRE_writing.reflection_initial_bilingual: Before asking AI, Andrea predicts: 'Where might I still have an error?' (*¿Dónde puedo todavía tener un error?*) — write 1 sentence prediction in EN or ES.

approved_prompt_templates_for_a12_learne: Prompt 1 — Grammar check (controlled): 'Find errors in this maritime inspection form. List ONLY the errors. Do NOT rewrite my text. Use simple English: [paste form].'
Prompt 2 — Preposition check (GT-S3-01..04): 'Are the prepositions ON, AT, IN, BEHIND, IN FRONT OF correct in this text? Reply yes/no per sentence: [paste Move 2].'
Prompt 3 — Verb check (GT-S3-05): 'Does each verb have the correct -s for 3rd person singular? List corrections only: [paste Move 4].'
Prompt 4 — There is/are check (GT-S3-07): 'Is the verb agreement correct after THERE? Reply yes/no per sentence: [paste Move 3 lines 1-2].'

The cargo is ON the warehouse. The vessel is AT Berth 4.' AI replies: 'Sentence 1 yes. Sentence 2 no — should be IN the warehouse (closed space). Sentence 3 yes.' Then she runs Prompt 3: AI confirms 'arrives ✓ leaves ✓ loads ✓' and Andrea writes 'IA acertó verbos · 8/8 GT presentes.'

auditors_checklist.title: THE AUDITOR'S CHECKLIST · Self-review before submission to Captain Restrepo
criteria_5: (1) My form has all 5 moves (header / location / status / operations / sign-off)
(2) I used ON, AT, and IN at least once each · plus at least one of UNDER/BEHIND/IN FRONT OF/NEXT TO/BETWEEN
(3) I have at least 3 verbs with -s (3rd person singular) and at least 1 verb without -s (plural/1st person) · with one AND-combined sentence
(4) I used 'is/are' descriptive twice and 'there is/there are' once
(5) My length is 60-90 words · sentences ≤12 words · register is formal operativo · no contractions

micro_capsules: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** ON for surfaces (deck, bridge, dock) · AT for points/times (Berth 4, 07:00, gangway) · IN for closed spaces (warehouse, office, cabin). (*ON para superficies · AT para puntos · IN para espacios cerrados.*)

> ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** Add -s when the subject is 'the vessel / the captain / the crew (singular collective) / Andrea / Lopera'. NO -s with 'I / we / they'. (*Agrega -s con tercera persona singular · 3rd person s.*)
> ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** THERE IS + singular noun (a bridge · a tug · a captain) · THERE ARE + plural noun (containers · pilots · ships). (*IS para singular · ARE para plural.*)
> 🛟 **Safety Cue:** A Pre-Shift Form that Captain Lopera cannot read = a shift that cannot start. Be clear, not creative. (*Un formulario que Lopera no pueda leer = turno que no inicia.*)
> 🤖 **AI Cue:** Use AI to FIND errors, never to WRITE for you. The form is yours. (*La IA encuentra errores · no escribe por ti.*)
> 📋 **Genre Cue:** A Pre-Shift Form has 5 moves: Header / Location / Status / Operations / Sign-off. If you skip one, the document is not the genre. (*Si saltas un move · no es el género.*)

targets_required_in_writing_task.structure: Prepositions of place — IN FRONT OF / NEXT TO / BETWEEN
